From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Security/VPC discovery  Acme follow-up

Hi Cameron  great talking earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of needs we heard:
- Private deployment (VPC) preferred for sensitive customer data; possible on-prem/air-gapped requirement for a subset of workloads.
- Need clarity on SOC 2 status, GDPR applicability across EU customers, and whether HIPAA applies for any PHI.
- Networking: strict network isolation, customer-managed KMS, and audit log retention requirements.

Action items / next steps:
1) Please share current SOC 2 status/documentation and any existing evidence (report or in-progress summary).
2) Confirm whether GDPR and/or HIPAA apply to your usage.
3) Kick off the vendor security questionnaire (SSQ) so our security team can validate controls  I can send our template.
4) If you can, share a high-level deployment diagram (network boundaries, private subnets, Egress restrictions) so we can validate architecture options (hosted Dedicated vs Private VPC vs on-prem air-gapped).
5) Proposal: follow-up call to review SSQ and deployment diagram  suggested slot: Wed 2027-11-17 10:00 AM PT. Does that work?

I'll loop Monica from Product Security to coordinate the SSQ and technical artifacts.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
https://www.redwoodinference.com

--

Thanks Marcus  appreciate the clear summary. A few quick answers and clarifications: 

- SOC 2: We are currently in the final stages of SOC 2 Type II readiness; audit is scheduled for Q1 2028. We can provide a SOC 2 readiness summary and control evidence exports now.
- GDPR: Yes  we have EU customers; GDPR applies.
- HIPAA: Not applicable for our current product set (no PHI).
- Deployment: We'll need a Private VPC option for production and an on-prem/air-gapped option for one regulated customer (legal has requested air-gap).

We can start the SSQ next week  please send your template. Wed 2027-11-17 10:00 AM PT works for a follow-up.

I'll get our security team to pull a high-level network diagram; they may prefer to redact some internal IPs.

Best,
